business_problem: However, ongoing staffing and financial stressors on the healthcare system create added challenges. "We hear from customers that healthcare staffing issues can put documentation quality at risk," says Dean Slawson, Vice President of Advanced Technology at PointClickCare.
solution_summary: However, ongoing staffing and financial stressors on the healthcare system create added challenges. "We hear from customers that healthcare staffing issues can put documentation quality at risk," says Dean Slawson, Vice President of Advanced Technology at PointClickCare. "Meanwhile documentation is a huge burden for clinicians who want to focus on delivering care. Medical documentation is complex-incomplete patient data puts providers and patients at risk. Patient documentation quality is also at an all-time low, and providers need support. The healthcare industry is experiencing historically low staffing. PointClickCare knew generative AI could help and built a pilot solution using Azure and Azure OpenAI Service to automate tasks and data analysis. It also used Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI, and Azure Databricks. With the new solution, PointClickCare developers report reduced development time, and customers report increased operational efficiency.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs the large-language-model features for classification, summarization, retrieval, or conversational responses in the solution.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Studio
solution_components.role: Provides the environment for building, testing, and orchestrating the customer's generative AI workflows.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Search
solution_components.role: Indexes enterprise content and retrieves relevant passages for AI-powered search and answer experiences.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Processes and transforms large datasets for analytics, modeling, and downstream reporting.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Publishes dashboards and reports so teams can monitor operations and act on live insights.

data_flow: Operational and business data is gathered from the customer's source systems processed in Azure Databricks and published to teams through Power BI dashboards.
